address: Tangxiang Cultural Space, 538 Xikang Road, Jingan, Shanghai, China Mainland
bio: The chiaroscuro ring logo connotes completeness and the complementary relationship of the enthusiastic chef duo, who travel around China regularly to keep their prix-fixe seasonal menu fresh and inspired. With sound Western techniques, they interpret traditionally Chinese memories with unique scents, tastes, textures and a touch of whimsy, eg Cantonese roast pork disguised as ice cream. Consider pairing the food with non-alcoholic drinks. Leave your preconceptions at the door and be wowed....
